_note: Seed state only. The runner rewrites this file every tick; the copy in git is what a fresh deploy starts from (Render's free disk is ephemeral). It deliberately carries NO 'bybit_real_start': that key anchors the notional book, and a stale anchor makes a fresh $X book start at $X plus months of unrelated PnL. With it absent the book anchors to the live exchange balance at boot, so it starts at exactly QUANT_CAPITAL.
